thesis: Universal Display (OLED phosphorescent materials and licensing) is debt-free on XBRL tags: at 2026-09-30 cash 93.4M plus short-term investments 340.0M = 433.5M, total liabilities 212.9M. From SEC XBRL data tied to the FY2025 10-K and the 10-Q filed 2026-10-28, TTM revenue is 627.7M (FY2025 650.6M - 9M2025 477.7M + 9M2026 454.8M), TTM net income 230.6M and diluted EPS 4.92, operating cash flow about 265.2M and capex about 33.6M (FCF about 231.6M). At the 2026-11-06 close of 88.31 and 45,023,810 shares (cover 2026-10-23) market cap is about 3.98B: 17.9x TTM EPS, 5.8% FCF yield. Nine-month revenue is down 4.8%, operating income down 17.2% and EPS down 4.3% (3.52 vs 3.68), so this is a profitable, cash-rich business whose earnings are currently shrinking.
counterthesis: Nine-month revenue fell 4.8% and operating income 17.2%, so trailing multiples flatter the current run rate: annualizing 9M2026 EPS (3.52 x 4/3 = 4.69) gives 18.8x. Quarterly revenue is lumpy (Q3 2026 revenue 160.4M was +14.9% versus 139.6M in Q3 2025 while first-half 2026 of 294.4M was down about 12.9% versus 338.1M, so the trend may be turning, which this record cannot confirm because the filing text was not read). The company depends on a few display makers and on OLED adoption; share repurchases of 193.0M in 9M2026 (vs 0 in 9M2025) reduce share count but consume cash. Sources limited to XBRL facts; no read MD&A, so revenue mix (materials vs royalties), customer concentration, tariff or China exposure and guidance are unknown.
invalidation: Revenue declining year over year for two more quarters; operating margin falling under about 30%; loss of a major licensee; buybacks exceeding free cash flow while the cash pile shrinks.
